beats.html:
It grew out of Samhain,
the Gaelic festival marking
the end of harvest.

The night the year turned
and the boundary
went thin.

People needed a ritual
for the part of the year
that gets dark.

Somebody you know is
dreading the dark months.
This one is for them.
